candidate: Optional dependency-free inventory comparison helper; does not replace the plan 1.1 contract
purpose: Expose bounded source-to-proposal differences so a reviewer can decide their meaning and authorization
inputs: Normalized snapshots with nonempty revision/case_id, concepts/records/entries arrays and unique IDs; proposed snapshot states basis_revision
comparison_layers: Concept IDs, labels, classification axis and optional hierarchy/scope
Record IDs, display labels, assigned concepts, declared roles and scope
Entry IDs, path, role, scope and assigned concept filters

output_semantics.valid_pair: COMPARED, decision NOT_EVALUATED; all differences are review evidence, not automatic defects or approval
output_semantics.malformed_pair: INVALID_INPUT with concrete location; no traceback or fabricated comparison
output_semantics.unknown_fields: Explicit list of fields the helper did not examine
limits: Snapshot truth and completeness are not established
Concept equivalence, approved changes and user comprehension remain manual
Actual authorization, redirects, search, index behavior and migration execution are untested

frozen_mechanical_cases: Equal source/proposal counts with missing ITEM-073 and added ITEM-X73
Changed membership edges while total and per-category counts stay identical
Changed scope ITEM-088 and expanded roles ITEM-090
Unknown-material assignments changed on six specified source IDs
Order-only changes to records and set-valued memberships do not create semantic deltas
Valid rename and unused-concept retirement remain observable changes without automatic failure
Duplicate IDs and invalid field types are rejected before dictionary indexing
Wrong basis revision is exposed even when records match
At least 1200 synthetic records with a single compensated ID loss are compared completely in this fixed population
no_claim: This is bounded data comparison correctness, not real large-service migration or human usability.
